sources.title: Andrews High Tech Automotive (Australian workshop) — "Mitsubishi Timing Chain Failure": on the 3.2 litre 4M41 in the Triton and Pajero, the hard plastic portion of the upper timing chain guide wears thin and breaks away, broken pieces get caught in the chain set and make the chain jump; the shop advises replacing the guide at 90,000 km intervals during a valve clearance check, and "have it inspected immediately and best not to drive the vehicle until you have done so" once the engine rattles

Mitsubishi Pajero 4x4 Life — "Pajero 3.2 DI-D common problems": describes a light rattle from the top of the engine on cold start that settles as oil pressure rises, attributes it to progressive wear of the plastic top timing chain guide, states that "a jumped or broken timing chain means bent valves, piston damage, and in most cases an engine that is not economically repairable", and notes that the fourth generation uses an updated guide design

Mitsubishi Pajero Owners Club (UK) forum — "Shogun 3.2 did timing chain failure, what's the likely damage?": the chain snapped and the top guide was missing entirely; a member explains that damage depends on engine speed at failure, that free camshafts assume a non-contact neutral position, that a break at high revolutions can bend valves and snap camshafts, and that a whipping chain can crack the timing gear case

en.title: Timing chain guide wear on the 3.2 diesel
en.summary: The plastic face of the upper timing chain guide wears thin, breaks up, and drops its pieces into the chain — and a chain that jumps on this engine bends valves. An Australian workshop that sees these regularly recommends replacing the guide preventively at a service interval, together with the valve clearance check, and says plainly that once the engine rattles you should have it inspected immediately and not drive it in the meantime. Two honest caveats. First, most of the published experience is from the third-generation version of this engine, and one of the sources below says the fourth generation uses an updated guide design; nobody in the sources cited establishes that the updated design is immune, and nobody establishes that it fails either. Second, a top-end rattle on a diesel has other explanations, so the steps below separate them before you commit to the expensive path. What is not in doubt is the consequence of ignoring it, which is why the triage is do-not-drive: the repair while it is a guide is a fraction of the repair once the chain has jumped.

symptoms.rattle-from-the-top-of-the-engine-on-col: A light rattle from the top of the engine on a cold start
symptoms.rattle-that-does-not-go-away-once-warm: A rattle that stays once the engine is warm and oil pressure is up
symptoms.rough-running-or-a-timing-fault-code: Rough running, or a stored fault code about camshaft and crankshaft correlation
symptoms.engine-will-not-start-after-a-noise: The engine stopped with a noise and will not restart

causes.worn-plastic-timing-chain-guide: The plastic face of the upper timing chain guide has worn thin and is breaking away
causes.stretched-chain-or-tired-tensioner: The chain has stretched or the tensioner can no longer take up the slack
causes.valve-clearances-out-of-adjustment: The valve clearances are simply out of adjustment, which sounds similar from outside
causes.chain-already-jumped: The chain has already jumped or broken and the engine is out of time

diagnosticSteps.listen-at-the-cam-cover-on-a-cold-start: Listen at the cam cover on a genuinely cold start and note whether the rattle is at the top of the engine or lower down
diagnosticSteps.note-whether-the-rattle-clears-with-oil-: Note whether the rattle fades within seconds as oil pressure builds, or stays regardless
diagnosticSteps.take-the-cam-cover-off-and-inspect-the-t: Take the cam cover off and inspect the upper chain guide face for grooving, thinning and missing pieces, and check the valve clearances while you are in there
diagnosticSteps.check-the-timing-marks-line-up: Turn the engine by hand and confirm the camshaft and crankshaft timing marks still line up where they should

replace-the-guide-with-the-valve-adjustm.title: Replace the guide during a valve clearance service
replace-the-guide-with-the-valve-adjustm.detail: The cited workshop treats this as scheduled maintenance rather than a repair: the guide is a cheap part, and doing it while the cam cover is already off for the valve clearances means very little extra labour.

full-timing-chain-set.title: Full timing chain, guides and tensioner
full-timing-chain-set.detail: If the chain has stretched or the tensioner is at the end of its travel, replacing the guide alone puts a new part next to worn ones. Do the set.

assess-the-engine-after-a-jumped-chain.title: Assess the engine after a jumped chain
assess-the-engine-after-a-jumped-chain.detail: Compression and a physical inspection before any money is spent. Members of the cited thread note that the damage depends on engine speed at the moment it let go — a low-speed failure can be survivable, a high-speed one can bend valves and snap camshafts, and a whipping chain can crack the timing gear case.

es.title: Desgaste de la guía de la cadena de distribución en el 3.2 diésel
es.summary: La cara plástica de la guía superior de la cadena de distribución se adelgaza, se rompe y le suelta los pedazos a la cadena, y en este motor una cadena que se brinca dobla válvulas. Un taller australiano que los ve seguido recomienda cambiar la guía de forma preventiva en un intervalo de servicio, junto con la revisión de la luz de válvulas, y dice sin rodeos que apenas el motor empieza a sonar hay que revisarlo de inmediato y no manejarlo mientras tanto. Dos advertencias honestas. Primero: casi toda la experiencia publicada viene de la versión de tercera generación de este motor, y una de las fuentes de abajo dice que la cuarta generación usa un diseño de guía actualizado; ninguna de las fuentes citadas demuestra que ese diseño sea inmune, y ninguna demuestra que también falle. Segundo: un traqueteo en la parte alta de un diésel tiene otras explicaciones, así que los pasos de abajo las separan antes de que usted se comprometa con el camino caro. Lo que no está en duda es la consecuencia de dejarlo pasar, y por eso el triaje es no manejar: la reparación mientras se trate de una guía es una fracción de la reparación una vez que la cadena se brincó.

symptoms.rattle-from-the-top-of-the-engine-on-col: Un traqueteo suave en la parte alta del motor al arrancar en frío
symptoms.rattle-that-does-not-go-away-once-warm: Un traqueteo que se queda aunque el motor ya esté caliente y con presión de aceite
symptoms.rough-running-or-a-timing-fault-code: Marcha irregular, o un código guardado de correlación entre árbol de levas y cigüeñal
symptoms.engine-will-not-start-after-a-noise: El motor se apagó con un ruido y ya no vuelve a encender

causes.worn-plastic-timing-chain-guide: La cara plástica de la guía superior de la cadena de distribución se adelgazó y se está desprendiendo
causes.stretched-chain-or-tired-tensioner: La cadena se estiró o el tensor ya no logra recoger la holgura
causes.valve-clearances-out-of-adjustment: La luz de válvulas simplemente está fuera de ajuste, y desde afuera suena parecido
causes.chain-already-jumped: La cadena ya se brincó o se quebró y el motor quedó fuera de tiempo

diagnosticSteps.listen-at-the-cam-cover-on-a-cold-start: Escuche sobre la tapa de válvulas en un arranque realmente en frío y determine si el traqueteo viene de la parte alta del motor o de más abajo
diagnosticSteps.note-whether-the-rattle-clears-with-oil-: Fíjese si el traqueteo se desvanece en segundos conforme sube la presión de aceite, o si se queda igual
diagnosticSteps.take-the-cam-cover-off-and-inspect-the-t: Quite la tapa de válvulas y revise la cara de la guía superior de la cadena buscando surcos, adelgazamiento y pedazos faltantes, y aproveche para medir la luz de válvulas
diagnosticSteps.check-the-timing-marks-line-up: Gire el motor con la mano y confirme que las marcas de sincronización del árbol de levas y del cigüeñal siguen coincidiendo donde deben

replace-the-guide-with-the-valve-adjustm.title: Cambiar la guía durante un servicio de luz de válvulas
replace-the-guide-with-the-valve-adjustm.detail: El taller citado lo trata como mantenimiento programado y no como reparación: la guía es una pieza barata, y hacerlo con la tapa de válvulas ya destapada para la luz de válvulas significa muy poca mano de obra extra.

full-timing-chain-set.title: Juego completo de cadena de distribución, guías y tensor
full-timing-chain-set.detail: Si la cadena se estiró o el tensor está al final de su recorrido, cambiar solo la guía es poner una pieza nueva al lado de piezas gastadas. Haga el juego completo.

assess-the-engine-after-a-jumped-chain.title: Evaluar el motor después de que la cadena se brincó
assess-the-engine-after-a-jumped-chain.detail: Compresión e inspección física antes de gastar un cinco. Los miembros del hilo citado anotan que el daño depende de a qué revoluciones iba el motor cuando soltó: una falla a bajas vueltas puede ser sobrevivible, una a altas vueltas puede doblar válvulas y quebrar árboles de levas, y una cadena suelta latigueando puede rajar la caja de distribución.
